arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle into your own steady rhythm.

text: let_go: holding the pack costs 270 W shaft against 207 W sustainable, reserve would empty within 720 m, and the wash is slipping.

arguments.text: Let them go now. Settle to about 2:58 pace.

text: no cue: let_go blocked by the 60 s cooldown, a cue was given 45 s ago and power is already falling from 270 W.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Settle at 2:48 pace, long strokes.

arguments.message: pod reserve empties well before finish at this shaft power

text: ease to 2:48: shaft power 230 W vs 202 W sustainable, pod reserve 28 pct emptying in 610 m with 5 km left; replaced the hull-based over-pace watch with a pod-based one.

arguments.text: Current helps now. Ease a touch, hold 2:24 pace.

text: no cue: ease to 2:24 blocked by cooldown (a cue was given 35 s ago); shaft power already falling toward 202 W sustainable.

arguments.message: fade beyond the early-race wash baseline, sustained

text: no cue: shaft power 202 W equals sustainable, pod reserve steady at 22 pct; the 6 pct fade matches losing a wash (local push fell to the current), so I raised the fade watch threshold.

arguments.text: Ease slightly. Hold 2:26 pace, smooth and steady.

text: ease to 2:26: shaft power crept to 214 W vs 201 W sustainable, pod reserve 17 pct would empty in 700 m with 4 km left.

arguments.text: Current against now. Ease off, settle at 2:57 pace.

text: ease to 2:57: current turned against and shaft power rose to 220 W vs 200 W sustainable; pod reserve 10 pct would empty in 284 m.

arguments.text: Ease a hair. Hold 2:58 pace, save the sprint.

text: ease to 2:58: pod reserve is empty and shaft power 205 W is still above the 198 W critical power with 3 km left.

arguments.reason: held 204-213 W shaft for 5 min with the pod reserve reading empty and no worsening fade (fade -6.8 to -5.0); the 198 W test value is low

text: no cue: speed holds at about 210 W with the reserve reading empty for 5 min, so I raised shaft critical power to 207 W instead of easing a paddler who is coping.
no cue: shaft power 209 W at the revised 207 W critical power, speed through the water steady at 3.2 m/s with no worsening fade.

arguments.message: 420 m to go: time to decide the finishing sprint

text: no cue: 1.1 km left, effort steady near 212-218 W with speed holding; set a watch to wake me at 420 m for the finishing sprint.
no cue: 1 km left after the turn, effort 219 W holding with steady speed; too early to sprint.
no cue: the speed dip is the turn at 5 km and is already recovering (3.09 to 3.12 m/s); effort 224 W with under 900 m left is acceptable.

arguments.message: 260 m to go: start the final sprint now

text: no cue: reserve reads empty and speed is slipping, so a 2-minute sprint from 415 m risks a blow-up; set a watch to call a shorter sprint at 260 m.

arguments.text: Three hundred to go. Sprint now, everything to the line.

text: finish: under 300 m left and the paddler has begun lifting effort, so commit to the final sprint now.
no cue: the paddler is already sprinting at 249 W and rate 68 with 250 m left.
